question: Identify the country that produced the most notable AI models among the United States, China, and Europe in 2024, then give that country’s 2024 private AI investment.

expected.answer: The United States: 40 notable models and USD 109.1 billion in private AI investment.
required_facts: United States leads the three reported regions with 40 models.
The same country had USD 109.1 billion in private AI investment in 2024.

evidence.text: In 2024, U.S.-based institutions produced 40 notable AI models, significantly surpassing China’s 15 and Europe’s combined total of three.
U.S. private AI investment hit $109.1 billion in 2024, nearly 12 times higher than China’s $9.3 billion and 24 times the U.K.’s $4.5 billion.

question: Which country both leads the 2023 AI patent grants highlighted in the report and has the highest AI optimism among the six countries contrasted in the Public Opinion highlights?

expected.answer: China: 69.7% of AI patent grants in 2023 and 83% optimism in the cited public-opinion comparison.
required_facts: China accounts for 69.7% of AI patent grants in 2023.
China has the highest optimism of the six listed countries, at 83%.

evidence.text: As of 2023, China leads in total AI patents, accounting for 69.7% of all grants, while South Korea and Luxembourg stand out as top AI patent producers on a per capita basis.

A large majority of people believe AI-powered products and services offer more benefits than drawbacks in countries like China (83%), Indonesia (80%), and Thailand (77%), while only a minority share this view in Canada (40%), the United States (39%), and the Netherlands (36%).

question: The report discusses a sharp fall in the cost of matching GPT-3.5 on a particular benchmark. On that same benchmark, which 3.8-billion-parameter model exceeded the 60% threshold in 2024?

required_facts: The GPT-3.5-equivalent cost comparison uses MMLU.
Phi-3-mini has 3.8 billion parameters and exceeded the cited MMLU threshold in 2024.

evidence.text: The cost of querying an AI model that scores the equivalent of GPT-3.5 (64.8) on MMLU, a popular benchmark for assessing language model performance, dropped from $20.00 per million tokens in November 2022 to just $0.07 per million tokens by October 2024 (Gemini-1.5-Flash-8B)

In 2022, the smallest model registering a score higher than 60% on MMLU was PaLM, with 540 billion parameters. By 2024, Microsoft’s Phi-3-mini, with just 3.8 billion parameters, achieved the same threshold—the equivalent of a 142-fold reduction in two years.

question: Among the protein models named as launched in 2024, which belongs to the model family associated with the highlighted 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and who received that prize?

expected.answer: AlphaFold 3 belongs to the AlphaFold family. Demis Hassabis and John Jumper received the Chemistry prize for protein-folding work with AlphaFold.
required_facts: The listed 2024 protein models include AlphaFold 3.
The Chemistry Nobel highlight links AlphaFold to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper.

evidence.text: In 2024, several large-scale, high-performance protein sequencing models, including ESM3 and AlphaFold 3, were launched.
Google DeepMind’s Demis Hassabis and John Jumper won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their pioneering work on protein folding with AlphaFold.
